problem_description: 設計 e-Bike mid-mounted drive unit (coaxial structure)，含 gearbox、motor、drive board、pedaling shaft (torque+angle sensing)。目標：小型(OD111mm/axial92mm)、輕量(2500g)、低噪(對標TQ HPR50)、高扭力(peak 125Nm/continuous 100Nm)。減速比約 1:30~1:35。

step0.note: 系統描述完整，含完整子系統和規格。5 組隱含矛盾已初步識別。無需 5Why/KT/CECA — 非故障排除而是新系統設計。直接路由 Step 1 功能建模。

TC1.improve: 提高馬達扭力密度至5Nm（支撐125Nm輸出）
TC1.worsen: 馬達外徑超過coaxial空間限制(Ø≤65mm)

TC3.worsen: 傳動效率下降或結構複雜化

TC4.worsen: 散熱面積不足，連續100Nm@8min溫升超標

tc_definitions.concretization: IPM rotor with V-shape flux-concentrating magnets; dynamic field weakening enables high Bg in compact diameter
tc_definitions.control_equation: T = (3p/2)[ψ_m·i_q + (L_d - L_q)·i_d·i_q] — reluctance torque adds ~30% on top of PM torque

tc_definitions.concretization: Multi-path load-sharing planetary gearset (N=4 planets per stage, 2 stages); dependent TC resolved by TC1+TC3+TC5 solutions combined
tc_definitions.control_equation: F_per_planet = F_total / (N·cos α); load sharing reduces individual gear size → lighter
tc_definitions.note: Dependent TC — substantially resolved by combination of TC1/TC3/TC5 solutions

tc_definitions.concretization: Helical planetary with micro-geometry optimization (tip/root relief, crowning); local tooth compliance while maintaining overall mesh stiffness
tc_definitions.control_equation: ε_total = ε_α + ε_β > 2.0; ΔK_mesh/K_mesh < 10% → noise -8dB vs spur

secondary_principle.name: Curvature
secondary_principle.application: crowned tooth profile for uniform contact stress distribution

tc_definitions.concretization: PCM (erythritol) thermal buffer integrated in shell cavity; absorbs peak heat via latent heat, dissipates during rest
tc_definitions.control_equation: Q_stored = m_PCM·ΔH_fus; erythritol ΔH=340 kJ/kg → ~70g buffers 24kJ peak (50W×480s)

tc_definitions.concretization: CF-PEEK gears with steel inserts at tooth roots for peak stress; topology-optimized AZ91D shell with material removed from low-stress regions
tc_definitions.control_equation: CF-PEEK σ_f ≈ 200 MPa (vs PA66 ~80 MPa); steel insert σ_y ≈ 800 MPa at root; σ_root = F_t/(m·b·Y_F·Y_S)

secondary_principle.name: Extraction
secondary_principle.application: topology optimization removes 20-30% shell material from low-stress regions

claims.claim: IPM V-shape flux concentration Bg_eff ≈ 0.9T at Ø65mm → T = 5Nm
4-planet load sharing reduces per-tooth load 75% → lighter gears
Helical ε_total > 2.0 + micro-geo → noise -8dB vs spur
70g erythritol PCM buffers 24kJ peak heat within ΔT limit
CF-PEEK σ_f ≈ 200MPa + steel inserts handles 125Nm peak

pc.required_notA: SMALL — for OD111mm coaxial space constraint (Ø≤65mm)
pc.separation_detail: IPM V-shape magnets concentrate flux in air gap (Bg ↑ 30-40%) without diameter increase; high Bg locally in gap, low volume globally

solutions.description: IPM rotor with V-shape flux-concentrating NdFeB magnets; reluctance torque contribution ~30%; Bg_eff ≈ 0.9T at Ø65mm → 5Nm achieved

pc.separation_detail: Individual tooth has micro-compliance (tip/root relief μm-level) while overall mesh stiffness maintained via helical overlap (ε_total > 2.0, always ≥2 teeth in contact)

solutions.description: Helical planetary gearset with micro-geometry optimization; tip relief + root relief + crowning; contact ratio ε_total > 2.0; noise -8dB vs spur gear baseline

pc.required_A: LIGHT — ρ low for 2500g system target
pc.required_notA: STRONG — σ_y high for 125Nm peak impact at tooth root
pc.separation_detail: Bulk gear body CF-PEEK (ρ ≈ 1.4 g/cm³, lightweight) with steel inserts at tooth roots (σ_y ≈ 800 MPa, high strength); overall gear is light but locally strong where needed

solutions.description: CF-PEEK gear body with press-fit steel inserts at tooth roots; topology-optimized AZ91D shell with 20-30% material removed from low-stress regions

pc.separation_detail: PCM (erythritol) absorbs peak heat via latent heat during high-load burst, then dissipates during rest periods; time-domain buffering decouples instantaneous heat from steady-state dissipation

solutions.description: Erythritol PCM (~70g) integrated in shell cavity as thermal buffer; ΔH_fus = 340 kJ/kg absorbs 24kJ peak heat; shell fins provide steady-state dissipation during rest

synergies: SOL-TC1 ↔ SOL-TC4: IPM higher efficiency → less heat generation → PCM budget more comfortable
SOL-TC3 ↔ SOL-TC5: Helical design benefits from CF-PEEK vibration damping properties
